Anritsu.why: Its Test & Measurement business sells evaluation and manufacturing-test instruments to optical transceiver makers (BERTWave MP2110A for 400GE/800GE/1.6TE modules, optical spectrum analyzer for CPO laser evaluation); AI data-center demand in the optical transceiver market drove T&M revenue +34% in Q1 FY2026.
Anritsu.evidence: Anritsu Q1 FY2026 results presentation (07-30-2026): 'In the T&M business, data center-related demand, such as in the optical transceiver market, remained strong due to the spread of AI'; Q&A: 'We have received orders for both 800GE and 1.6TE related products.'

players.product: Optical transceiver test instruments: BERTWave MP2110A (400GE/800GE/1.6TE module manufacturing test), MP1900A Signal Quality Analyzer, MS9740B optical spectrum analyzer for CPO/LD evaluation

quarterly_data.quarter: Anritsu IR meeting materials: FY2026 Q1 Investor Presentation (08-17-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Data center test lineup: BERTWave MP2110A for optical transceiver manufacturing evaluation (simultaneous four-channel measurement, 200G/Lane signal evaluation, 400GE/800GE/1.6TE signals, new support for 1.6TE modules) and CPO optical waveform evaluation; MS9740B optical spectrum analyzer for optical transceiver / LD evaluation for CPO; ME7848A opto-electronic network analyzer for silicon photonics / device chip evaluation up to the 110 GHz band; new MT9100A multi channel fiber tester for multicore fiber; MP1900A signal quality analyzer for PCIe Gen6/Gen7. Company market overview: manufacturing ramp-up of 1.6TE optical transceivers
